content: If you are allergic to this medication or have any other allergies, inform your doctor or pharmacist before using it. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Additionally, this medication contains various sugars, which may affect blood sugar levels in individuals with diabetes. If you have diabetes, monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as directed and share the results with your doctor. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you use this medication for an extended period, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as blood mineral levels) should be conducted to monitor your condition. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments as scheduled. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
